notes: All 6 required web searches ran this time, plus 2 extra (8 total); none of the topic searches (superintelligence, extinction, pause, China agreement, AI safety) returned anything about Wittman. Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act (H.R. 10538, introduced 24 September 2026 by Casar): sources describe about 9 cosponsors, all Democrats; no source shows Wittman as a cosponsor, but a full cosponsor list was not seen. The page-fetch tool returned the Genesis Mission statement in short segments; the quote used is one segment, which continues ' it is a domain of national security and strategic advantage,'. The letter itself (a linked PDF) was not read. The 2025 op-ed quote was confirmed again through the page-fetch tool this run. A 2023 press release on co-sponsoring the National AI Commission Act (saying AI 'can also lead to serious harm without proper regulation', paraphrased in search results) is before 2025 and was left out. Wittman is vice chairman of House Armed Services and has pushed military AI and autonomy (2023 release); hearing remarks were not searched in detail and would likely be D under ruling 3. The earlier run's direct site check found no AI mention in press releases from 22 July to 28 October 2026.
